dogecoin.text:
If you got burnt on $DOGE you 100% deserve it. I have absolute zero sympathy for you.

The writing is all over the wall in bright red letters.

You hitched your financial wagon to Elon Musk and a cartoon dog.

It's okay though. Someone has to buy the top.

this got some attention so to clarify:

- I made money on $DOGE, I’m not allergic to dogs
- I’ll probably do it (scalp) again
- my long term bet is on $ETH
- you are absolutely *high* if you think a 13,000% increase in market cap makes sense, is sustainable, etc
